Conhecimento em gestão de caixa, planejamento de liquidez e gestão de risco cambial. Conhecimento de produtos bancários, operações financeiras e processos de tesouraria. Conhecimento em controles internos, compliance e requisitos regulatórios. Excel avançado para análises financeiras, modelagem e elaboração de relatórios. Experiência com sistemas de gestão de tesouraria, preferencialmente Kyriba ou plataformas similares. Capacidade analítica para interpretação de dados financeiros e resolução de problemas. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento com stakeholders internos e externos. Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades, cumprir prazos e atuar com organização e atenção aos detalhes. Perfil colaborativo, com foco em melhoria contínua, eficiência operacional e gestão de projetos. Espanhol e Inglês será considerado um diferencial. Certificação profissional em Tesouraria (CTP) será considerada um diferencial.

title: Senior marketing designer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior marketing designer em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Senior Marketing Designer    Shoplift · Remote · August 2026        About Shoplift    Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.    Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.    We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.    We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.        The Role    As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.    This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2 B Saa S marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.    Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2 B Saa S company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the Saa S . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.  And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2 C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by "brand recognizes brand" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.    You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.        This is a range role, not a specialty role    You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.    That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.        How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure    This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.    We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.  Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse , and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.  You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.        What You'll Do    Marketing creative & campaign assets Design static ad systems for Meta, Linked In, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency  Brand & sales materials Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale  Product marketing visualization Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets  You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.        What success looks like    By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.    By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.        You're a Great Fit If…    Must-haves 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2 B Saa S portfolio Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)  Nice-to-haves Motion design or animation Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention      How we work, and who does well here    High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.    Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. " It looked great" is not a result.    Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.        What We Offer Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually Flexible remote work Generous time off policy Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand Build your portfolio with high-quality B2 B Saa S work that stands out Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product      How to Apply    Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:      You'll be asked to include:   Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2 B Saa S marketing work) One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked. How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?  We're excited to meet you.

title: Head of accounting
description:
Nova oportunidade para Head of accounting em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About MAVI      MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.      We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.      The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.      Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and Soft Bank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.      The Role      We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.      This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.      Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.      The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.      You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.      What You'll Own      The Close and Financial Reporting     The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time. The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P& L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors. Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them. Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it. Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.    Controls, Policy, and Audit     Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established. Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual. Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out. External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.  Accounting Operations   The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards. Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them. Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.    Team, Systems, and Standard     Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client. Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across Net Suite, Quick Books Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation. A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.    What We're Looking For     10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant Substantial ERP experience with Net Suite, Quick Books Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, , Rippling, or Flo Qast Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded Saa S or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field    Who This Role Is For      This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.      You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.      Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.      Why Join Through MAVI     Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day    Work Arrangement      This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.    Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager      Company Overview:    b Td Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. b Td operates under three innovative models:  B2 C (exclusive membership services),  B2 B (corporate travel management), and  B2 B2 C (travel concierge services for business partners). Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to  b Td travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.      CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)    We are looking for two (2)  CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.      Main Responsibilities   • Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.   • Handle client requests, changes, and special services via Whats App and email.   • Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.   • Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.   • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.      Requirements   • Experience in luxury or corporate travel.   • Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level   (An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)   • Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.   • Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.   • Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.   Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages. Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required. Effective training and delegation skills, with a "learning by doing" approach. Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively. • Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus      Why Join Us   • Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.   • Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.   • Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.   • Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements      b Td Travel Culture:    At b Td, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.    b Td is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside b Td, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.      Terms of Employment: Employment under  CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) . Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where b Td operates. This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility. Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.    Compensation: Competitive base salary. Night shift extra hours Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs. Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets. Health and dental insurance. Food card. Birthday day off. Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to  Head of Corporate Globally as b Td evolves through its funding rounds. Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the b Td team.    Important Note Before Applying:    Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your  Linked In profile or  updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just "gets it" — we need a  self-starter ready to deliver results from  day one .    Forget gaming Linked In algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.    Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!      b Td Travel – Where Business Meets Innovation.

title: Banco de talentos - pcd
description:
Empresa está contratando Banco de talentos - pcd em jacareí. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Banco de Talentos - PCD      Sany no Mundo      Trabalhando no Futuro. Quer participar desse futuro, então conheça Sany.    A SANY é uma empresa voltada para o futuro que nasceu em uma época de mudanças e agora busca qualquer oportunidade nessas mudanças que abrirão o caminho para o futuro.    Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, a visão da SANY de construir uma empresa de primeira classe, promover funcionários de primeira classe e fazer contribuições de primeira classe para a sociedade.    Temos nos concentrado em agregar valor aos clientes, funcionários, acionistas e ao público, oferecendo produtos e serviços de alta qualidade,    Proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho cheio de oportunidades, divulgando relatórios financeiros para atender às expectativas dos investidores e exercendo nossa própria influência para ajudar os necessitados.    Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.    Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.      Sany do Brasil      No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².    Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.    Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.    No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.    A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filial própria pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.    E agora a Sany está com novos planos para o Brasil. Breves Novidades

Empresa está contratando Técnico de gestão fundiária i em curitiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a Copel    Somos a Copel, uma das maiores empresas integradas de energia do Brasil com atuação em geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização. Nossa força vem da nossa gente. Nós criamos as nossas próprias oportunidades e reconhecemos o potencial das pessoas, pois sabemos que cada um pode contribuir e fortalecer ainda mais a equipe. Buscamos profissionais que querem se desenvolver junto com o negócio e que estejam preparados para grandes desafios: da infraestrutura que move o Brasil às soluções sustentáveis que protegem o amanhã. Somos feitos de energia e atitude. Venha fazer parte da Copel.      Técnico de Gestão Fundiária I tem como foco principal a atuação em gestão e regularização de imóveis afetados por obras da Copel DIS , combinando atividades de campo, análise documental, negociação e apoio jurídico/fundiário.      Principais atividades: Negociar indenizações com proprietários afetados pelas obras. Preparar documentação para ações de servidão e desapropriação . Levantar e registrar danos decorrentes das obras. Coletar documentos para elaboração de escrituras públicas. Interpretar plantas, memoriais descritivos e pareceres técnicos. Atender questões fundiárias relacionadas aos acessantes do sistema de distribuição. Alimentar e atualizar o cadastro de imóveis no sistema fundiário. Auxiliar em processos de regularização imobiliária.    Requisitos obrigatórios: Curso técnico em Edificações, Construção Civil, Negócios Imobiliários, Agricultura ou área similar . CNH categoria B . Disponibilidade para viagens aproximadamente 2 semanas por mês .  Diferencial importante: experiência com negociação de indenizações, documentação imobiliária, cartórios, prefeituras e levantamentos topográficos.      Benefícios:    Na Copel você encontra benefícios pensados para apoiar a sua jornada! Prêmios por Desempenho (PPD) e Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR). Suporte completo para você e sua família com Auxílio Creche, Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendida.      Call to Action    Conheça essa e outras oportunidades em nossa Página de Carreiras e no Linked In. Nossas vagas também estão abertas para candidaturas de Pessoas com Deficiência (PCDs).

title: Diretor de qualidade

title: Supervisor(a) de recrutamento e seleção - operações
description:
Confira a vaga para Supervisor(a) de recrutamento e seleção - operações em marília. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Na Dori | Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox’s Burton’s Companies e The Fine Biscuits Company, somos reconhecidos e amados por pessoas de todas as gerações pela alegria que compartilhamos com elas – uma alegria feita pelas nossas pessoas. Junte-se a nós e descubra um mundo cheio de possibilidades, onde sua paixão encontrará o seu lugar.      A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Há mais de seis décadas, com um time de mais de 3000 colaboradores, produzimos produtos que acompanham gerações e fazem parte da história e das lembranças de milhões de famílias, com marcas icônicas como Gomets®, Yogurte 100®, Pettiz® e Disqueti®.      Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach’s®, Jelly Belly®, Swee TARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry’s.      Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.      Sobre a vaga      O Supervisor(a) de Recrutamento e Seleção será responsável por liderar a execução dos processos de Recrutamento e Seleção para posições operacionais, técnicas e de liderança nas unidades fabris da empresa, garantindo agilidade, qualidade das contratações e aderência às necessidades do negócio. Atuará na gestão da equipe de recrutamento, relacionamento com gestores e implementação de iniciativas que contribuam para a atração e retenção dos melhores talentos para as operações industriais.      Localidade: Marília - SP      Reporta a: Gerente de Talent e Performance      Modelo de trabalho: Presencial      Contamos com você para:     Assegurar a execução eficiente dos processos seletivos para posições operacionais, técnicas e de supervisão. Implementar estratégias de atração de talentos para atender demandas de fábrica, logística, manutenção e áreas de apoio industrial. Garantir o cumprimento dos indicadores de recrutamento, incluindo SLA das vagas, tempo de fechamento, qualidade da contratação e satisfação dos gestores. Atuar como parceiro dos líderes de operações, entendendo necessidades de mão de obra e propondo soluções de recrutamento aderentes ao planejamento do negócio. Gerenciar processos de recrutamento em volume, campanhas de contratação e projetos especiais de expansão ou ramp-up produtivo. Estabelecer parcerias com consultorias, escolas técnicas, instituições de ensino, programas de aprendizagem e demais fontes de atração de talentos. Monitorar tendências do mercado de trabalho e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de seleção. Garantir uma experiência positiva aos candidatos durante toda a jornada de recrutamento. Conduzir entrevistas por competências para posições estratégicas e de liderança operacional. Elaborar análises e relatórios gerenciais com indicadores, identificando oportunidades e riscos relacionados à aquisição de talentos. Assegurar conformidade com políticas internas, legislação trabalhista e diretrizes de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão. Apoiar iniciativas de employer branding voltadas ao público industrial.    Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença: Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas; Vivência com recrutamento de alto volume para posições operacionais e industriais. Experiência na liderança de equipes de recrutamento. Atuação prévia em ambientes industriais, manufatura, logística ou centros de distribuição.    O que nós oferecemos:    Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:     Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Dr Dori (telemedicina) Seguro de vida Totalpass e/ou Wellhub Vale alimentação Vale refeição Vale Natal Vale transporte Descontos em produtos    Igualdade de Oportunidades      Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.      A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC  ).      Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

title: Fincrime analyst (investigations) - brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Fincrime analyst (investigations) - brazil em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.      As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.      People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.        About the role    Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.      We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we’re treating customers fairly. You’ll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.      To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.      Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.        What you'll be doing Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes      What you'll need A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate) 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level) Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.g., financial institutions, law enforcement) Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts) The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends      Nice to have Fluency in other languages A degree in law or a STEM subject A professional certification (e.g., ICA or ACAMS) Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis      Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.    We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.    Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.  We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.    By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Aeronautical electrical systems designer - junior
description:
Confira a vaga para Aeronautical electrical systems designer - junior em são josé dos campos. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Summary Description      We are looking for a Junior Aeronautical Electrical Systems Designer to work on the development and detailing of electrical systems in civil and military aeronautical programs. The professionals will participate in system design and integration activities, working under the guidance of more experienced professionals and contributing to the development of technical solutions aligned with program requirements and aeronautical certification standards.      Key Responsibilities:   • Support the development of aeronautical electrical installation projects in a 3 D CAD environment;   • Prepare and review electrical diagrams, wire lists, bills of materials (BOM), and technical documentation;   • Assist in the detailing of electrical installations, wiring routing (EWIS), and definition of supports and fixings;   • Support the specification of aeronautical components, materials, connectors, harnesses, and hardware;   • Assist in the integration between electrical systems, structures, hydromechanical systems, and avionics;   • Participate in system integration and segregation analyses;   • Support the manufacturing, assembly, and installation activities of electrical systems;   • Assist in development testing, qualification, and certification activities;   • Participate in the analysis and implementation of technical requirements under the guidance of the team;   • Interact with multidisciplinary teams for the development of engineering solutions;   • Contribute to the preparation of technical documentation in accordance with internal processes and certification requirements.      Requirements    Education   • Technical course in Electrical, Electronics, Electrotechnics, Mechatronics or related areas.    Desirable:   • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Aeronautical Engineering or related areas (in progress or completed).      Experience   • Between 2 and 6 years of experience in electrical design or aeronautical systems.   • Previous experience in an aeronautical environment will be considered a plus.      Technical knowledge    Electrical Systems Design Project   • Basic concepts of design and detailing of aeronautical electrical installations;   • Reading and interpreting electrical diagrams;   • Basic concepts of wiring diagrams;   • Basic concepts of wire lists and bills of materials (BOM);   • Basic concepts of wiring routing (EWIS);   • Basic concepts of integration of aeronautical electrical systems;   • Basic concepts of installation of embedded electrical and electronic equipment;   • Basic concepts of aeronautical electrical hardware, materials, and components.      Aeronautical Knowledge   • Basic concepts of the Aeronautical Product Development Process;   • Basic concepts of EWIS (Electrical Wiring Interconnection System);   • Basic concepts of system integration and segregation;   • Basic concepts of aeronautical manufacturing and assembly;   • Best practices for installing aeronautical systems;   • Basic knowledge of development, qualification, and certification testing;   • Basic knowledge of the aircraft certification process will be considered a plus.      Tools    Desirable experience with tools such as:   • CATIA V5 / 3 DEXPERIENCE;   • Microsoft Office.      Desired skills   • Interest in learning and developing technically;   • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills;   • Organization and planning;   • Good verbal and written communication;   • Multidisciplinary teamwork;   • Ease of interpersonal relationships;   • Proactivity and sense of responsibility;   • Commitment to quality, safety, and deadlines;   • Adaptability to work in a dynamic environment.      Differentials    Knowledge or experience in the following will be considered a plus:   • Aeronautical electrical projects;   • EWIS (Electrical Wiring Interconnection System);   • Electrical diagrams and wiring diagrams;   • CATIA V5 or 3 D EXPERIENCE;   • E3.series (Zuken) or IGE+XAO;   • Aeronautical manufacturing processes;   • FAR/CS 23 or 25;   • DO-160; • Technical English focused on aeronautical documentation.      Languages   • Intermediate English for reading and interpreting technical documentation.   • Advanced English will be considered a plus.      Availability   • National and international travel, when necessary.   • Willingness to work different shifts, as needed by the company.      What do we expect    We are looking for professionals interested in building a career in the aeronautical industry, who are eager to learn, have a collaborative spirit, and are committed to technical excellence. We expect proactive, organized, and motivated individuals to develop high-quality engineering solutions, contributing to the success of programs and their professional growth within the Systems Engineering team.

title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
Nova oportunidade para Crypto operations specialist em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About us    Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.    About the role    Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.    What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.  What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.  Nice to have Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.  What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Structural analysis engineer - mid level
description:
Empresa está contratando Structural analysis engineer - mid level em são josé dos campos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Summary Description    We are looking for a Mid-Level Structural Analysis Engineer to support aerospace and/or aeronautical engineering projects, with a focus on metallic and/or composite structures. The engineer will be responsible for performing static analysis, fatigue analysis, and damage tolerance evaluations to support product development, certification, modifications, and in-service support activities.    The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in structural calculations, interpretation of technical requirements, engineering drawings, finite element modeling, and technical report preparation. A solid understanding of strength of materials, structural mechanics, margins of safety, and structural substantiation methods is required.    Key Responsibilities:   - Perform static analysis of aircraft structures using hand calculations and/or finite element methods.   - Support fatigue and structural life assessments under technical guidance.   - Support damage tolerance evaluations, including crack growth assessment and inspection criteria.   - Prepare finite element models, loads, boundary conditions, and basic correlation activities.   - Prepare clear and traceable technical reports aligned with certification requirements.   - Interface with design, loads, materials, certification, manufacturing, and product support teams.    Desired Qualifications:   - Degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.   - Approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in structural analysis.   - Experience with tools such as Nastran, Patran, FEMAP, Hyper Mesh, Abaqus, ANSYS, or similar.   - Experience with metallic and/or composite aircraft structures.   - Knowledge of static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance, structural margins, and certification documentation.   - Technical English for reading, report writing, and engineering communication.

title: Demand planning and inventory manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Demand planning and inventory manager em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Location: Remote (LATAM based)    Reports to: Senior Operations Manager    Employment Type: Full time    Salary: $35 K USD      About the Role    We are looking for a dedicated, full time Demand Planning and Inventory Manager to own forecasting and inventory accuracy across our portfolio of consumer products brands. This is a company with multiple direct to consumer subscription brands, one single purchase DTC brand, and two wholesale brands sold through major retail partners.      This role sits at the center of how we plan and manage inventory. The single most important thing this person owns is making sure our forecasting is accurate and that our recorded inventory position actually reflects reality, by working closely with our warehouse team to reconcile sales order activity against physical cycle counts every week. You will be the person who catches a forecasting error before it becomes a stockout, who catches an inventory discrepancy before it throws off a reorder decision, and who builds the reporting infrastructure that lets leadership see true inventory health at a glance across every brand and channel.      This is a dedicated, single client role. You will not be splitting your time or attention across other companies or accounts.      Key Responsibilities    Demand Planning and Forecasting Analyze sales velocity across all DTC brands and forecast demand by SKU Determine and execute reorder timing and quantities for DTC brands to avoid stockouts and overstock Incorporate seasonality trends and channel performance data from ecommerce, Amazon, retail marketplace, and social commerce channels into forecasting and reorder decisions Coordinate directly with our overseas production team on reorder needs, production timing, and inventory availability    Sales Order and Inventory Reconciliation Own the process of pulling sales orders across all sales channels, including wholesale retail partners and marketplace channels, and ensuring inventory is accurately and promptly decremented as orders ship from our warehouse Maintain a real time, accurate view of true available inventory at all times, since forecasting, reordering, and fulfillment decisions all depend on this number being correct Review and reconcile weekly cycle count data provided by the warehouse shipping and receiving coordinator against expected inventory levels based on sales order activity Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, tracing issues back to root cause, whether that is a sales order processing error, a receiving error, or a physical count error Note: this role reviews and reconciles cycle count data but does not have supervisory authority over the warehouse coordinator, who reports separately to the Senior Operations Manager  Reporting and Visibility Maintain a formal reorder tracker and replenishment schedule, kept current and accessible to leadership Build and maintain regular reporting on inventory health, discrepancy trends, forecast accuracy, and stock levels across all brands Proactively communicate inventory risks and planning recommendations directly to leadership, rather than waiting to be asked  Additional Responsibilities Create, track, and reconcile purchase orders, flagging issues before they affect operations Own the shipment calendar and deadline tracking for inventory sent into third party fulfillment centers, including Amazon FBA, ensuring shipments are submitted on time to prevent sales disruption Track replenishment needs and coordinate reorder timing and order minimums with our wholesale retail partners Maintain organized, accessible documentation for vendor contracts and communications  What We Are Looking For Prior experience in demand planning, forecasting, or inventory management, ideally spanning both DTC and wholesale or retail channels Strong analytical skills and genuine comfort working with numbers, forecasts, and reconciliation data in Excel or Google Sheets A precise, detail obsessed mindset, this role requires someone who catches small numerical discrepancies before they become larger problems Experience with Amazon marketplace operations, including FBA shipment coordination, is a plus Experience coordinating with overseas manufacturing or production teams is a plus Excellent written and verbal communication skills for working with internal teams, vendors, and retail partners Ability to work as a dedicated, full time resource for a single company Comfort working independently in a remote structure with regular reporting cadence to leadership    Reporting Structure    This role reports to the Senior Operations Manager. It works closely with, but does not supervise, the warehouse shipping and receiving coordinator, who reports separately within operations.      Why Join Our Team A stage of company where you will help build forecasting and inventory reporting infrastructure from the ground up, not just follow existing systems Full ownership of demand planning and inventory accuracy across multiple brands A collaborative, low ego team environment where your work has direct, visible impact Steady operational culture that values precision and clear communication

Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin: Where purpose comes to life.    You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.      Every day, we are thinking big and working smart to solve some of the toughest challenges impacting the world. Whether it’s facilitating clean drinking water for communities, creating climate resilient cities, or designing more comfortable living spaces, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Achieve zero accidents resulting from work activities. Reduce the incidence of occupational diseases. Establish action plans in Industrial Safety, Environment and Occupational Health (HSE). You have +5 years of experience as a leader (supervisor, coordinator) in Safety and Hygiene, Environment & health in manufacturing industry.   English proficiency, we will have our interview in English. The position requires preparing reports, attending audits and meetings in English.   You are a teamplayer, motivator and excellent communicator with an entreprenaurial drive.      What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers    Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B& I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.      Organization    Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B& I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B& I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.      Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.      Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.    Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

Combinando pensamento estratégico e execução prática, sendo capaz de traduzir metas em planos claros e realizáveis. Constrói relacionamentos baseados em confiança, escutando ativamente e ajustando sua abordagem conforme o contexto e as necessidades dos clientes, transmitindo mensagens de forma clara, convincente e concisa.. Você prevê conflitos antes que eles aconteçam, com base no conhecimento da dinâmica interpessoal e de grupo. A função exige, ainda, disciplina operacional, responsabilidade e zelo constante pelas pessoas, organização, segurança e ambiente de trabalho.      Para este cargo, você precisará: Formação superior em Engenharia (Qualidade, Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas); Experiência com qualificação de fornecedores e auditorias de qualidade; Inglês avançado (para contato com fornecedores internacionais); Conhecimento da ISO 9001; Mínimo 3 anos de experiência liderando equipes na área de Qualidade e laboratório de Qualidade; Conhecimentos avançados com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas; Local de trabalho: Barueri, SP.    Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam: Desejável Pós Graduação em Gestão / Engenharia da Qualidade e Certificações relacionadas; Conhecimento em Ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e 6-Sigma; Conhecimento em ERP Omega da ABC71 Familiaridade com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas Leitura e interpretação de documentos em inglês    Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:    Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Oferecemos um pacote completo de benefícios, pensado para promover bem-estar, desenvolvimento profissional, equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e trabalho e segurança .      Entre eles:   Assistência Médica e Odontológica Benefícios de Alimentação e Refeição Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Modelo de Trabalho Flexível Programas de Saúde, Bem-estar e Qualidade de vida Incentivos à educação e desenvolvimento contínuo Benefícios voltados à família e à parentalidade Seguro de vida e acesso a parcerias e programas corporativos   ✨ Na Trillia, você encontra um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e orientado a dados, onde profissionais têm autonomia, voz e espaço para evoluir.     #Vem Pra Trillia

Conheça a Blanver:    A Blanver é uma empresa brasileira com mais de 42 anos de história marcada pela inovação e empreendedorismo. A experiência e atuação no desenvolvimento, fabricação e comercialização de medicamentos e insumos farmacêuticos ativos (IFAs) tornou a Blanver especialista nos segmentos de HIV, Hepatite e Osteoporose, oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade, atendendo pacientes no Brasil por meio de parcerias com o Ministério da Saúde e laboratórios oficiais. Além disso, também estamos presentes nos segmentos de Oncologia, Doenças Raras e Hematologia, por meio de parcerias estratégias com grandes parceiros internacionais.    As operações do Grupo Blanver contam com duas plantas de produção no Brasil – uma na cidade de Taboão da Serra, onde são fabricados os medicamentos, e a outra em Indaiatuba, para a produção de IFAs. Além destas, temos um escritório central no bairro Morumbi em São Paulo e uma filial de expedição na cidade de Itajaí, SC. Acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a grande diferença na consolidação dos nossos negócios e estamos dedicados a desenvolver equipes em que cada pessoa é reconhecida por sua experiência e suas contribuições exclusivas.    Essas serão algumas das atividades do dia-a-dia como Ajustador Ferramenteiro: Executar serviços de controle, limpeza e organização dos ferramentais de embalagem, compressão e de processos. Dar suporte ao setor de produção, seguindo orientações verbais ou consultando os procedimentos técnicos operacionais. Realizar as atividades de controle, guarda e manutenção das ferramentas de uso coletivo no departamento de controle industrial, visando disponibilidade diária para atendimento em todas as operações da empresa e monitoramento dos sistemas de monitoramento das condições ambientais e produção de água purificada.  Requisitos: Técnico em Ferramentaria; Competência para colaborar efetivamente com colegas de diferentes departamentos, garantindo que as ferramentas atendam às necessidades específicas da produção farmacêutica e contribuam para a eficiência geral da operação; Competência em operar e ajustar máquinas-ferramenta, como tornos, fresadoras e retíficas, para fabricar e ajustar componentes de ferramentas com precisão; Disponibilidade para atuar em Taboão da Serra.  Para te apoiar nessa jornada:   • Assistência Médica;   • Assistência Odontológica;   • Seguro de vida;   • Vale Alimentação;   • Restaurante;   • Auxílio funeral;   • Auxílio creche;   • Gympass e Total Pass;   • Plano de Saúde Pet;   • Auxílio filho excepcional conforme CCT;   • Subsídio ou reembolso - Material Escolar;   • Subsídio de medicamentos;   • Auxílio ótica;   • Day off de aniversário;   • Emenda de feriados;   • Recesso no final do ano ou férias coletivas;   • Benefícios sazonais (datas comemorativas);   • PLR.    Na Blanver, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para as vagas, sem distinção de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, gêneros, deficiências, orientações sexuais, identidade de gênero, idades diversas e gerações .

description:

Que desafio temos para você?    Estamos em busca de um(a) Bombeiro(a) para atuar no time de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho.      Quais as responsabilidades?    Atuar nas emergências conforme os procedimentos operacionais padrão de cada cenário emergencial;    Organizar, capacitar e coordenar as brigadas industriais e agrícolas;    Conduzir veículos de emergência (ambulância e caminhão pipa);    Programar e executar teste, inspeção, ensaio, limpeza, substituição e/ou reposição de equipamentos, veículos, sistemas de proteção de combate a incêndio e de atendimento as emergências;    Treinar os brigadistas em combate a incêndio, vazamentos de produtos químicos, primeiros socorros e outros;    Registrar as intervenções, elaborar relatórios de simulados, intercorrências e atas de turno;    Organizar, conduzir e ou coordenar simulado de emergências conforme os cenários de riscos mapeados.      Quais os requisitos?    Curso de bombeiro profissional civil (vigente);    CNH C ou D;    Curso de transporte de veículos de emergência (vigente);    Pacote Office;    Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos;    Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.      Qual localidade?    Olímpia - SP      O que buscamos num profissional?      Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.    A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.      Sobre a Tereos      Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.      Tereos no Brasil      A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Analista financeiro
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista financeiro em pouso alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Objetivo:      Responsável pela execução, controle e análise das rotinas de Contas a Pagar , garantindo o correto processamento de pagamentos, cumprimento de prazos, aderência às políticas internas e suporte à gestão financeira da unidade industrial da Midea.      Responsabilidades: Executar e controlar o processo de Contas a Pagar, assegurando pagamentos corretos e dentro dos prazos acordados. Conferir, validar e lançar notas fiscais, faturas, contratos e boletos no sistema. Realizar conciliações e controles de pagamentos, adiantamentos e reembolsos. Acompanhar e controlar vencimentos, fluxo de pagamentos e programação financeira. Garantir conformidade com políticas internas, controles internos e compliance. Atuar na interface com fornecedores para esclarecimento de dúvidas, divergências e regularizações. Apoiar o fechamento financeiro mensal, garantindo acuracidade das informações. Manter controles e relatórios atualizados para acompanhamento da gestão. Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo documentações e informações necessárias. Contribuir com melhorias de processos, automações e padronizações da área financeira.    Requisitos e Qualificações Ensino superior completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia em Contas a Pagar, preferencialmente em ambiente industrial ou multinacional. Conhecimento em rotinas financeiras, lançamentos, conciliações e fechamento. Experiência com ERP (SAP ou similar). Excel intermediário a avançado. Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de urgência e boa comunicação.

title: Veterinary radiologist
description:
Nova oportunidade para Veterinary radiologist em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Veterinary Radiologist - Remote      About Signal PET      Signal PET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.      Role Overview      We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.      Key Responsibilities     Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies. Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports. Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases. Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide. Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects. Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.    Qualifications     Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária . M. V., MSc or M. V., Ph D preferred. 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging. Strong diagnostic and communication skills. Proficient in English (written and spoken). Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented. Comfortable working independently and remotely.    What We Offer     Fully remote role (Brazil-based). Supportive, international team and culture. Full training provided—no prior AI experience required. A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.     *** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***      This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to Linked In messages sent to arrange interviews.    Please ensure that you check your Linked In messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.    We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.
